description: Items requiring operator clarification — ambiguous items with multiple plausible interpretations

possible_interpretations: I1: All 13 layers fully implemented and validated
I2: Minimum viable layers (auth, database, deployment, error tracking) plus all critical security fixes
I3: App builds, auth works, basic tests pass, can deploy to Fly.io
I4: Different per app — LyfeOS may already be 'production ready enough', while EOS/CreatorOS are not
clarifications.recommended_interpretation: I4 — define per app. LyfeOS needs hardening of existing deployment. EOS/CreatorOS need foundational work before any deployment.
clarifications.why_clarification_is_needed: Readiness gates cannot be evaluated without a concrete definition. 'Production ready' is currently a qualitative judgment, not a measurable threshold.

possible_interpretations: I1: App calls UMH API for intelligence/agent execution
I2: UMH monitors app health and enforces governance gates
I3: App reports telemetry to UMH for cross-app analytics
I4: Full bidirectional integration — app uses UMH agents, UMH governs app deployments
clarifications.recommended_interpretation: I2 for near term, I4 as long-term vision. Start with governance (readiness gates, deployment approval) before building active intelligence integration.
clarifications.why_clarification_is_needed: UMH integration work packets need a scope. Building full bidirectional integration first is premature. Governance-first is lower risk.

clarifications.unclear_item: What UMH should own vs what each app should own in the 13-layer stack
possible_interpretations: I1: UMH owns nothing app-specific — pure policy and observation
I2: UMH owns deployment orchestration and security gates for all apps
I3: UMH owns the full DevOps layer (CI/CD, deployment, monitoring) for all apps
clarifications.recommended_interpretation: I2 — UMH orchestrates deployment and enforces security gates. Apps own their code, data, and infrastructure configuration. UMH does not own app CI/CD or monitoring implementation.
clarifications.why_clarification_is_needed: Integration boundary must be clear before building UMH-app contracts. Overreach makes apps dependent on UMH for basic operations. Underreach misses the governance value.

clarifications.unclear_item: Whether shared standards should remain documentation-only until implementation readiness
possible_interpretations: I1: Documentation-only — advisory, not enforced
I2: Enforced via CI when CI exists
I3: Enforced selectively — security and auth standards mandatory, others advisory
clarifications.recommended_interpretation: I1 for now, I3 when CI exists. Standards can't be enforced without CI infrastructure. When CI is built, enforce security-critical standards first.
clarifications.why_clarification_is_needed: Determines how strictly OS Platform Standard v2 gates app development.
downstream_artifacts_affected: OS Platform Standard v2 implementation plan

clarifications.unclear_item: Whether current Replit-origin project structure should be modernized before deployment
possible_interpretations: I1: Full restructure to modern conventions before any deployment
I2: Deploy as-is, refactor incrementally
I3: Fix only what breaks deployment, leave the rest
clarifications.recommended_interpretation: I3 — pragmatic approach. Fix deployment blockers, not aesthetics.
clarifications.why_clarification_is_needed: Affects effort estimation for deployment work packets. Full restructure is significant work.

clarifications.unclear_item: Whether PostHog is product analytics only or part of broader observability
possible_interpretations: I1: PostHog = product analytics only. Separate service for error tracking and logging.
I2: PostHog covers analytics + error tracking (PostHog has error tracking features).
I3: PostHog for analytics, Sentry for errors, Grafana for infra monitoring.
clarifications.recommended_interpretation: I1 for planning purposes. Evaluate PostHog error tracking capabilities when closer to deployment.
clarifications.why_clarification_is_needed: Affects 13-layer production stack Layer 12 design for all apps.

clarifications.unclear_item: What must be true before Fly.io deployment infrastructure can be created
possible_interpretations: I1: Just build and deploy — fix issues in production
I2: Source converged + auth working + basic tests
I3: Full 13-layer design ratified + CI/CD pipeline + test suite + security review
clarifications.recommended_interpretation: I2 with security minimum — source converged, auth working (not bypassed), basic test suite, build succeeds. Full 13-layer completion is the end state, not the deployment gate.
clarifications.why_clarification_is_needed: Determines when infrastructure work packets unlock.

clarifications.unclear_item: What must be true before Neon database provisioning for EOS and CreatorOS
possible_interpretations: I1: Provision immediately with current schema, migrate later
I2: Wait for source convergence (EOS) and MVP scope (CreatorOS) to finalize schema
I3: Provision a development database now, production database later
clarifications.recommended_interpretation: I2 — wait for schema-affecting decisions before provisioning. Provisioning on an unfinalized schema creates migration debt.
clarifications.why_clarification_is_needed: Database provisioning is a dependency for multiple layers.
